summary: First test run for SC2 Mod Command Center. Backend pytest suite (13 tests) passes 100%: projects CRUD (list/create/update/delete + 422 & 404 error paths), model inspect (glb/obj + .txt reject), model export (Weapon+Item+Icon+Texture zip with Y_UP DAE, Block-only). Frontend Playwright tests pass on Project Tracker (add/search/edit/delete + toasts), Log Reader (5 grouped error cards with ×2/×3 counts and expected fix hints for FrostWolf.dae, Textures/Creatures/FrostWolf.png, broken entity template, Unrecognised error), Template Builder (preset -> parse -> per-attribute form -> generate XML with new Name=IceWolf & MaxHealth=30), Model Prep (canvas renders, mode toggles, scale disabled in Block, snapshot hidden in Weapon, .obj upload populates 8 verts/12 faces/size, snapshot creates icon preview, export downloads box_sc2.zip), and mobile bottom tab dock (all 4 tab-*-mobile buttons switch tabs at 390x844).

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}'. Non-blocking a11y warning — add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to DialogContent for a11y compliance.

action_items: Optional a11y: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to project-dialog to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `Optional` imported but used correctly; overall clean.
Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer lifespan handler (non-blocking).
Consider validating target_length upper bound to avoid extreme scale values (currently only lower-bounded to 0.001).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_ prefixed projects were created and deleted during tests; no residual seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py can be reused. All 8 review flows verified end-to-end. WebGL renders in headless Chromium — canvas + snapshot + zip export all work. Radix Select in modals requires small wait between trigger click and option click (200-300ms).
